description: Check that a versioned dimension is temporally coherent, per key. Reports intervals that overlap, so a point-in-time lookup returns two rows; gaps, so it returns none; more than one live version; an interval ending before it starts; and a current flag that disagrees with its own interval. Intervals are treated as half-open, so a row ending exactly where the next begins is contiguous rather than overlapping. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

csv.description: The versioned dimension. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.

current_flag.description: A column marking the live version. When supplied, a flag that disagrees with its interval is reported.

delimiter.description: Single field separator. Defaults to a comma.

key.description: The business key, which repeats once per version. A composite key is supported. Values are canonicalised exactly, so 42 and 42.0 are the same key and a large identifier is compared as text rather than collapsed.

open_end_value.description: The value meaning "still live", such as 9999-12-31. Defaults to empty.

valid_from.description: The interval start column. ISO-8601 dates or timestamps, because bounds are compared as text.

name: slowly_changing_dimension_integrity

coherent.description: True only when the dataset was fully read and every key had exactly one live version, no overlap and no gap.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the data was not, which is a different problem from data that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

row.description: 1-based and counting the header, so it matches a text editor.

keys.description: Per key: version count, open intervals, current rows and the first and last start.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Slowly Changing Dimension Integrity
